import pixeltable as px

# Initialize the client
px.init()

# Reference the existing videos table
videos = px.get_table('videos')

# Create a view that expands each video into one row per frame at 1 fps
frame_view = px.create_view(
    'video_frames',
    select=[videos],
    iterator_col=videos.video,
    iterator=px.Video.extract_frames(fps=1)
)

# Verify the view was created
print(f"Created view: {frame_view.name}")
print(f"Columns: {[col.name for col in frame_view.columns()]}")
